name: Western Medical Equipment
old_description: Here at Western Medical Equipment, we recognize that being injured makes things difficult on your lifestyle, mobility, and finances. We provide our customers with a wide variety of home health products that will safely, effectively, and affordably assist in your recovery process.
about:
Since its foundation in 2008, Western Medical Equipment, LLC has operated from Jackson, Wyoming, providing affordable home medical supplies to the surrounding region.

The company rents and sells a broad range of home health products, including mobility aids such as power scooters, electric wheelchairs, manual wheelchairs, knee walkers, rollators, and walkers; respiratory equipment like tanked oxygen and home and portable oxygen concentrators (with a prescription); bath safety items, hospital beds, CPAP machines, ramps, lift chairs, wound-care supplies, lymphedema treatment products, and pressure-reduction bedding. It also stocks a variety of Medela breast pumps and accessories, and offers a curated line of hemp-derived cannabinoid (CBD) products at discounted prices. The business runs a physical location at 180 North Center Street and provides in-house billing assistance for insurance reimbursement.

Western Medical Equipment serves individuals recovering from surgery or injury, patients with chronic respiratory conditions, new and expecting mothers, and anyone needing mobility assistance. Its customers include private payers and those using insurance, with a prescription required for oxygen equipment.

The company says it was started to make essential medical supplies affordable and accessible, and it differentiates itself through in-house insurance billing support and a selective, high-quality CBD product line offered at a discount.
